hotspots.name: giant robot head
hotspots.look: A robot head the size of a house, retired without ceremony. Somebody stuck it here and told nobody why.

hotspots.name: broken eye
hotspots.look: One eye is smashed. Through the crack, something metallic glints inside, like a plan.

hotspots.name: chasm
hotspots.look: A chasm. You can't see the bottom, which is the one detail the rumours agree on.

hotspots.name: metal plate
hotspots.look: A sharp-edged plate of metal, lying about like an invitation to a mistake.

hotspots.name: way west
hotspots.look: Back towards the mountain of garbage.

hotspots.name: conveyor belt
hotspots.look: A conveyor belt that carries things to a hydraulic crusher. It's the only thing on this ship that's running on time.

hotspots.name: crusher
hotspots.look: A steel block the size of a bus. It rises, falls, and doesn't take the day off.

hotspots.name: drainage pipe
hotspots.look: A drainage pipe just beneath the crusher. A very bad idea, helpfully lit.

hotspots.name: service ladder
hotspots.look: A service ladder up to the overhead rails. Somebody's coffee cup is still on the first rung.

hotspots.name: way west
hotspots.look: Back to the mountain.

hotspots.name: warp-core reactor
hotspots.look: A reactor glowing with the particular green that says 'do not touch' in every language.

hotspots.name: iron ladder
hotspots.look: A rusty iron ladder up to a crane platform. Each rung is a small act of faith.

hotspots.name: rat's pipe
hotspots.look: From the dark inside come two red eyes, and the sound of something that eats nobody's leftovers.

hotspots.name: suspension platform
hotspots.look: A platform bolted to the ceiling by someone who was in no hurry for a pay review.

hotspots.name: cyan rail
hotspots.look: A long rail along the ceiling. Something dangles from it, taking its time.

hotspots.name: magenta tower
hotspots.look: A support tower painted in a colour chosen by someone who clearly never had to look at it.

hotspots.name: grabber
hotspots.look: A grabber hangs from the rail, waiting for a hand to move it.

hotspots.name: way down
hotspots.look: Back down the service ladder.

hotspots.name: monitor
hotspots.look: An old green monitor showing the room below. In real time, and very green.

hotspots.name: joystick
hotspots.look: A joystick, worn smooth by many hands that are now elsewhere.

hotspots.name: red button
hotspots.look: A big red button. It's red for a reason; nobody wrote down what.

hotspots.name: window
hotspots.look: Through the glass you see the reactor, glowing in its pit like a bad idea.

hotspots.name: ladder hatch
hotspots.look: The way back down.

hotspots.name: Aluminum Mallard
hotspots.look: A ship stitched together from scrap. It's the first thing in the universe that's all yours. Technically.

hotspots.name: engine manifold
hotspots.look: An open engine mount. Plainly waiting for something glowing and expensive.

hotspots.name: boarding ramp
hotspots.look: A boarding ramp. Not exactly inviting, but it does lead inside.

hotspots.name: pilot's seat
hotspots.look: The pilot's seat. Somebody has been sitting in it for years, in spirit.

hotspots.name: navigation computer
hotspots.look: A computer that thinks about it for a while, then says maybe.

hotspots.name: viewscreen
hotspots.look: Space. A great deal of it. Mostly nobody's.

hotspots.name: exit hatch
hotspots.look: The way out.

hotspots.name: launch lever
hotspots.look: Pulls the ship out into space. (Dev shortcut: takes you to Phleebhut.)

hotspots.name: planet readout
hotspots.look: Planet Phleebhut. Light atmosphere. One known settlement. You've been to worse places and paid more to see them.

hotspots.name: star map
hotspots.look: A grid of stars so wide that your pointer seems to apologise.

hotspots.name: 1. Resume scan
hotspots.look: Scans the next sector.

hotspots.name: 2. Set course
hotspots.look: Sets a course. Not yet connected. (Work in progress.)

hotspots.name: 3. Return
hotspots.look: Back to the cockpit.

hotspots.name: Aluminum Mallard
hotspots.look: Your ship, parked at a slight angle, like a regret.

hotspots.name: rock arch
hotspots.look: A rock arch the colour of an alien's idea of nature.

hotspots.name: stone spires
hotspots.look: Sharp green spires. A quick glance says 'don't', a long one says 'really don't'.

hotspots.name: desert path
hotspots.look: A path east, towards a giant shape in the distance. Possibly a shop.

hotspots.name: canyon path
hotspots.look: A path south into a canyon.

hotspots.name: sign
hotspots.look: 'WORLD O' WONDERS.' Both words are used with remarkable optimism.

hotspots.name: shop entrance
hotspots.look: The entrance. Inside, a salesman is waiting. He's been waiting since before the planet cooled.

hotspots.name: giant claws
hotspots.look: A pair of giant claws holding up the shop. Whatever they belonged to is not coming back for them.

hotspots.name: little table
hotspots.look: A little table. A postcard rack, a stray alien sock.

hotspots.name: way west
hotspots.look: Back to the landing strip.

hotspots.name: rock arch
hotspots.look: A natural arch. Nothing about this planet is natural for anyone from elsewhere.

hotspots.name: green spire
hotspots.look: A spire like a thorn from some enormous rose.

hotspots.name: mountain trail
hotspots.look: A steep trail up the mountain.

hotspots.name: way back
hotspots.look: Back to the landing strip.

hotspots.name: stalk plant
hotspots.look: A carnivorous stalk plant. Its tendrils drip with something that is not water.

hotspots.name: pods
hotspots.look: Pulsating pods hang from the ledge. They throb, as if listening.

hotspots.name: trail down
hotspots.look: Back down the trail.

hotspots.name: Monolith Burger station
hotspots.look: An orbital station shaped like a hamburger. Billions served. Billions regretted.

hotspots.name: docked ship
hotspots.look: Your ship is docked at the lower bun, like a bad habit.

hotspots.name: airlock
hotspots.look: The airlock. A sign inside says 'Please enjoy responsibly', which makes it clear nobody means it.

hotspots.name: counter
hotspots.look: A counter streaked with something that was a meal in a previous life.

hotspots.name: clerk
hotspots.look: A teenage alien clerk who looks as though he's been bored since before you were born.

hotspots.name: menu board
hotspots.look: The menu board offers eight kinds of burger. All taste of the same disappointment.

hotspots.name: arcade cabinet
hotspots.look: A cabinet for a game called Astro Chicken. It blinks like it knows something.

hotspots.name: tables
hotspots.look: Tables bolted to the floor. A sensible precaution, given the food.

hotspots.name: airlock
hotspots.look: Back to your ship.

hotspots.name: screen
hotspots.look: A chicken falls slowly through a toxic sky. You know the feeling.

hotspots.name: play game
hotspots.look: Drop in a coin and take the stick.

hotspots.name: step back
hotspots.look: Step away from the machine.

hotspots.name: trampoline pad
hotspots.look: Land softly on the pad. Ten times, apparently.

hotspots.name: press F5 to exit
hotspots.look: Leave the game.

hotspots.name: Aluminum Mallard
hotspots.look: Your ship on the ridge, smoking quietly to itself.

hotspots.name: lava pit
hotspots.look: A pit of glowing lava. It looks like the sunset, if the sunset wanted you dead.

hotspots.name: path south
hotspots.look: A narrow stone path south.

hotspots.name: shaky bridge
hotspots.look: A rope bridge over a chasm of lava. Strictly for people who've made peace with their choices.

hotspots.name: path back
hotspots.look: Back to the crater.

hotspots.name: path east
hotspots.look: On to the station.

hotspots.name: telescope
hotspots.look: A telescope pointed at the distant dome. It's been left alone, which has never happened to a telescope before.

hotspots.name: green crate
hotspots.look: A green crate stamped 'DANGER, NOT A TOY'. A fine toy.

hotspots.name: wind meter
hotspots.look: A wind meter. The wind here has opinions.

hotspots.name: researchers
hotspots.look: Two ScumSoft researchers in blue, arguing about whose turn it is to look important.

hotspots.name: way back
hotspots.look: Back to the bridge.

hotspots.name: path ahead
hotspots.look: A path to the ridge.

hotspots.name: research dome
hotspots.look: A silver dome of ScumSoft design, shiny, secure and entirely without taste.

hotspots.name: satellite dish
hotspots.look: A dish that points at a sky nobody else wants. It hums, as if bored.

hotspots.name: way back
hotspots.look: Back to the boulder field.

hotspots.name: ridge path
hotspots.look: A path to the ridge.

hotspots.name: metal pole
hotspots.look: A gleaming metal pole, quite unharmed, lying in the middle of the destruction like a promise.

hotspots.name: crater
hotspots.look: A smoking crater where something used to be. You'd rather not think about what.

hotspots.name: way back
hotspots.look: Back to the dome.

hotspots.name: ScumSoft building
hotspots.look: The ScumSoft headquarters. Each window is a monitor; each monitor is turned to look at you.

hotspots.name: ScumSoft sign
hotspots.look: SCUMSOFT. They don't even pretend.

hotspots.name: door
hotspots.look: A door in the side of the building. A scanner winks next to it.

hotspots.name: radar dish
hotspots.look: A dish that watches all the sky for the one thing that will upset them.

hotspots.name: landing pad
hotspots.look: Your ship waits on the pad, looking small and out of place.

hotspots.name: shelves
hotspots.look: Shelves of cleaning supplies. Every bottle says 'Not for Consumption' in a tone of long-suffering.

hotspots.name: coveralls
hotspots.look: A janitor's coveralls, hanging like a surrender.

hotspots.name: locker
hotspots.look: A locker with something inside that looks like a handheld vaporizer.

hotspots.name: bucket
hotspots.look: A bucket. The only thing here that isn't pretending to be more.

hotspots.name: door
hotspots.look: Back to the corridor.

hotspots.name: cubicles
hotspots.look: Cubicles in endless rows. Each has a drone, a lamp and a look like a closed door.

hotspots.name: trash cans
hotspots.look: Full trash cans. Each looks like the end of somebody's career.

hotspots.name: way back
hotspots.look: Back to the closet.

hotspots.name: boss's office
hotspots.look: The office of the boss. The nameplate is longer than the person.

hotspots.name: desk
hotspots.look: A desk so large it needs its own zip code.

hotspots.name: portrait
hotspots.look: A portrait of the boss, looking exactly as important as he'd like to be.

hotspots.name: copy machine
hotspots.look: A copy machine. It's making copies of something it ought not to be copying.

hotspots.name: door
hotspots.look: Back to the cubicles.

hotspots.name: security door
hotspots.look: A heavy security door. It has a scanner, and presumably a grudge.

hotspots.name: glass pods
hotspots.look: Two glass pods. Inside: the two weariest men in the galaxy, writing spreadsheets.

hotspots.name: console
hotspots.look: A control console blinking its small, uncaring lights.

hotspots.name: door
hotspots.look: Back to the office.

hotspots.name: blast door
hotspots.look: A blast door to the hangar.

hotspots.name: arena
hotspots.look: A combat arena in the middle of the hangar. Nobody installed it to be friendly.

hotspots.name: mech suits
hotspots.look: Two mech suits with boxing gloves. An engineer had a day.

hotspots.name: door
hotspots.look: Back to the cell block.

hotspots.name: ship hatch
hotspots.look: The way to the ship.

hotspots.name: radar
hotspots.look: A radar. It shows enemies in front, behind and everywhere between.

hotspots.name: shield meter
hotspots.look: The shield meter. Higher is better, as with most things.

hotspots.name: viewscreen
hotspots.look: Space. Full of things that want your ship for scrap.

hotspots.name: galaxy
hotspots.look: A whole galaxy, and for once you're not mopping any of it.
